Vento Sacro gains bonus damage from walking nonstop. It caps at 5 flat damage multiplied by level, up to 40 flat damage at Level 8. The actual bonus comes from distance walked divided by 200,000 up to the cap. This bonus will reset once the character stops moving. The unit for distance walked is slightly arbitrary and is not as big as it seems in the game. Limit Break levels do not further increase the cap. The weapon also creates a trail of light blue particle effects that arcs upward. The longer they last indicates the bonus being higher.

you have, the more likely you are to deal critical hits. Luck can be increased with

Vento Sacro has a normal amount of knockback, but it has an Area-of-Effect that can be controlled unlike most weapons, so it can be useful when trying to escape enemies closing in on you.
Moving vertically while facing only one direction with a wall behind you can be very effective.
